summary: Tiny campus service lane beside the UQ Aquatic Centre wall; loading zone, no room.
reasons: Narrow lane, building wall 2 m away

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto university buildings and a tree strip; busy campus, not residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane between trees and a large building; no clear ground beside it to pull out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Campus service and pedestrian traffic; a nearby crossing and loading area.
drivers.convention: Signed loading zone Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, 2 hours max; no overnight parking convention.

flags: Mapped bollards nearby (not on only access)
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the west side; large roof to the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is open to vehicles at night
